scripts.contracts:lint: redocly lint contracts/openapi/public-v1.yaml contracts/openapi/customer-conversation-candidate-v1.yaml contracts/openapi/customer-bff-v1.yaml contracts/openapi/internal-v1.yaml contracts/openapi/workforce-v1.yaml && node tools/check-runtime-contracts.mjs && node tools/check-workforce-capabilities.mjs
scripts.sdk:generate: npm run generate --workspace @vfbiz/api-client && npm run generate --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-api-client
scripts.governance:check: npm run docs:check && npm run reports:check && npm run authorization:check && node tools/work.mjs check && node tools/check-agent-governance.mjs
scripts.test:governance: npm run adapters:check && npm run agent-control:check && npm run work-control:check && npm run governance:check && npm run contracts:lint
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/api --if-present && npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal --if-present && npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:governance && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify:api: npm run lint --workspace @vfbiz/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @vfbiz/api && npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace @vfbiz/api && npm run prisma:validate --workspace @vfbiz/api && npm run build --workspace @vfbiz/api
scripts.verify:apps: npm run lint --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run typecheck --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run test:integration --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run build --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run lint --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal && npm run typecheck --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal && npm run test --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal && npm run test:integration --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal && npm run build --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal
scripts.verify:apps:e2e: npm run test:e2e:required --workspace @vfbiz/customer-portal && npm run test:e2e:required --workspace @vfbiz/workforce-portal
scripts.verify:ai: cd backend/ai && uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright && uv run pytest && uv run alembic upgrade head --sql > /dev/null
scripts.verify:ai:integration: test "${VFBIZ_RUN_DB_INTEGRATION:-}" = "1" && test -n "${VFBIZ_AI_DATABASE_URL:-}" && cd backend/ai && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run pytest tests/integration -q
scripts.verify:drupal: cd drupal && ddev composer validate --strict && ddev composer phpcs && ddev composer phpstan && ddev composer phpunit && ddev drush config:status
scripts.verify: npm run verify:governance && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:apps && npm run verify:ai && npm run verify:drupal
